headline: Emaar Plans Delisting of Construction Unit Following $3.3 Billion Buyout
summary: Emaar has announced plans to delist its construction unit after its board approved a $3.3 billion buyout offer driven by strategic considerations.
why: Emaar is a prominent real estate development conglomerate in the United Arab Emirates managing large-scale urban infrastructure projects.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Multi-billion-dollar corporate buyouts alter ownership structures and liquidity within regional property and construction sectors.
